fullPassage: Dreams do not always become reality. According to one study, 96% of adults in the UK are not currently working in their childhood dream job. The study also revealed lawyer and teacher to be the most achievable dream jobs. Fourteen percent of those who had dreamed of teaching reported working in education, with the same percentage of those who had wanted to be a lawyer reporting that they were employed in the legal, law enforcement, or security sector. Other dreams, like becoming an athlete or actor, were less likely to come true, and the most common sectors in which individuals dreaming of these careers ended up working were hospitality, events management, and accountancy. Is it really important to achieve one's childhood dream, though? In fact, it is. It can affect one's future happiness. Ninety-two percent of those working in their dream job reported being happily employed, while 84% of those doing something different reported being happy. In other words, those who did not achieve their dream were twice as likely to be unhappy.

(A) She often <u>dream</u>ed about becoming a famous actress when she was young. Every night, she would <u>dream</u> of standing on a grand stage.

(B) Is it really important to achieve one's childhood <u>dream</u>, though? In fact, it is. It can affect one's future happiness.
questions.stem: 다음 (A), (B)의 밑줄 친 dream의 의미로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: (A)의 dream은 동사로 '꿈을 꾸다', (B)의 dream은 명사로 '꿈, 이상'.
det.analysis:
❌ ① 의미가 뒤바뀜
✅ ② (A) 꿈을 꾸다 — (B) 꿈, 이상: (A)는 dreamed/dream 동사형, (B)는 childhood dream 명사형 ←정답
❌ ③ (B)도 '꿈꾸다'로 보면 명사 dream과 불일치
❌ ④ (A)가 동사인데 명사로 해석하면 불일치
det.tip: dream: 동사 '꿈을 꾸다', 명사 '꿈, 이상'. 품사로 의미 구분

questions.stem: 다음 영영 정의에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은? "the business of providing food, drink, and accommodation to guests and visitors"

det.korean: hospitality = 환대업 (손님과 방문객에게 음식, 음료, 숙박을 제공하는 사업)
det.analysis:
❌ ① accountancy(회계): 재무 관련이지 음식/숙박 서비스가 아님
❌ ② education(교육): 교육 분야이지 음식/숙박과 무관
✅ ③ hospitality(환대업): 음식, 음료, 숙박을 손님에게 제공하는 사업이라는 정의에 정확히 부합 ←정답
❌ ④ enforcement(집행): 법 집행 관련이지 음식/숙박과 무관

questions.passage: Ninety-two percent of those __________ (work) in their dream job reported being happily employed, while 84% of those doing something different reported being happy.
questions.stem:
다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로, 1단어)

work → ____

det.korean: 꿈의 직업에서 '일하고 있는' 사람의 92%가 행복하게 고용되어 있다고 보고했다.
det.analysis: those + 현재분사(working)로 '~하고 있는 사람들'이라는 의미. those working in their dream job = 꿈의 직업에서 일하고 있는 사람들. of 다음 those가 주어가 아니라 분사의 의미상 주어 역할.

questions.passage: Is it really important to achieve one's childhood dream, though? In fact, it is. It can affect one's future __________  (happy).
questions.stem:
다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로, 1단어)

happy → ____

det.korean: 어린 시절 꿈을 달성하는 것이 미래의 '행복'에 영향을 미칠 수 있다.
det.analysis: 소유격(one's) + 형용사(future) 뒤에는 명사가 필요. happy(형용사)를 명사형 happiness(행복)로 변환. one's future happiness = 미래의 행복.
det.tip: happy(형용사) → happiness(명사). 소유격+형용사 뒤에는 명사가 와야 함

questions.passage: Dreams do not always become reality. According to one study, 96% of adults in the UK are not currently working in their childhood dream job. The study also revealed lawyer and teacher to be the most achievable dream jobs. Fourteen percent of those who had dreamed of teaching reported working in education, with the same percentage of those who had wanted to be a lawyer reporting that they were employed in the legal, law enforcement, or security sector. Other dreams, like becoming an athlete or actor, were less likely to __________, and the most common sectors in which individuals dreaming of these careers ended up working were hospitality, events management, and accountancy. Is it really important to achieve one's childhood dream, though? In fact, it is. It can affect one's future happiness. Ninety-two percent of those working in their dream job reported being happily employed, while 84% of those doing something different reported being happy. In other words, those who did not achieve their dream were twice as likely to be unhappy.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 실현되다(come true). 운동선수나 배우의 꿈은 '실현될' 가능성이 더 낮았다는 문맥.
det.analysis:
❌ ① be replaced(대체되다): 꿈이 대체된다는 표현은 문맥에 맞지 않음
❌ ② be forgotten(잊혀지다): 꿈이 잊혀진다는 것은 이 문맥에서 다루지 않음
❌ ③ stay hidden(숨겨져 있다): 꿈이 숨겨져 있다는 것은 문맥과 무관
✅ ④ come true(실현되다): Other dreams were less likely to come true라는 원문에 정확히 부합 ←정답
det.tip: come true = 실현되다, 이뤄지다 (dreams come true)

det.analysis:
